Ah, you over there. Uh…

This program is brought to you all by
hacking your eyes and ears鷙

To be honest, I was planning to explain
once I finished off #C236196003Rin#CDEF, buttt…
#C236196003BB#CDEF is verry sorry.

―――Don't be deceived. AI doesn't lie.
In that moment, #C236196003BB#CDEF probably came to kill
#C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF, not you.
Huh? Is that #C236196003#SVT#CDEF?
Huh? Is that #C236196003#SVT#CDEF?
Huh? Is that #C236196003#SVT#CDEF?
Huh? Is that #C236196003#SVT#CDEF?
Okay, no problem.
A shield?
A wall?

Just what exactly is that Shield?
Does everyone here know?

In the Labyrinth's Core is a revolutionary,
girl-integrated firewall!

That means―――
#C236196003Rin#CDEF was… being used as a human tool…!?
―――Wait.

She says that she just used #C236196003Rin#CDEF and that girl
as Cores, meaning――

The next boss of the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF,
the sentimental #C000246204Sentinel#CDEF, makes her debut♪
This boss is exotic and academic!
#C236196003Rani VIII#CDEF!

…hmm?
Unlike #C236196003Rin#CDEF, #C236196003Rani#CDEF doesn't talk very much.
Now everyone understands, yes?
That design is this Sentinel system.
Take as much time as you need.
Ah. Just please be careful, okay?
Fundamentally, I loathe every one of you―――
and licking my lips, see?
Welcome to the proving grounds!
Uhh, happy-very what-what?
Good… evening?

Was it embarrassing shouting out a big
greeting to an empty corridor?
…I don't follow.

She IS listening to us! Darling, can we leave?
For all that's good and just, let's tear this
studio apart, please!
The #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF's rules really WERE wrong!

Satisfied after saying her piece, #C236196003BB#CDEF sends the
camera's (?) frame up and away.
Just what is your goal?
Can't we discuss things?
Never mind.

My goal?
Isn't it obvious?
To punish my defiant Senpai――physically.鷙
#C236196003BB#CDEF giggles, glaring dead at us.
I'm not open to discussions.

This is about suspense, remember?
I need you to go around the school and
Labyrinth. Roaming! Resisting! Groveling!
I tried asking why she calls me "Senpai."
A weak, calm, and pitiful ring!鷙
It's what I like calling you. That's all.
And with that…

Are you ready, Senpai?鷙
Take this! It's my personal #C000246204SG#CDEF!!!
Gwah…!?

Huh?
This… is #C236196003BB#CDEF's #C000246204SG#CDEF!?
Pshh! Of course I'd have one.

Even the Great Devil #C236196003BB#CDEF's still a girl,
deep down. She's got her secrets.
Eh? Really?

………………umm.
Don't you like, want to know what my aim is?
Can't say I do.
Fiiine. But don't come crying to me later!
Woohoo! It's Bonus Tiiime!
Ding dong dang dooong～

Huh? You didn't pick me up!
It was more like you killed me.
Just what are you tryin' to pull here?
Eek! #C236196003Greenchee#CDEF is so scaaary!
I see, I see.

One look from those bedroom eyes would
make most girls faint, wouldn't it?

Guwaaaaa!
What the――?! OWWW!

Teehee!☆
Sorryyy!
100,000,000 damage almost looks like cheating…
Okay! Reviiive――♪
…agh. I wanna die.
Talking with your Servant.

The name of the game is…
"No talking"!
Okaaay. So, did you catch that, Senpai?

Sorry. Physical contact is especially
prohibited.
Ahh, how can this be…?
Good evening.
Your horror, #C236196003BB#CDEF!
I laughed so hard I cried!
Abandon me to her #C000246204Alter Egos#CDEF…?
Ah! Oopsies, that was a secret♪
―――#C236196003Archer#CDEF?

How about penciling us into your time schedule
and giving us health management?
I just reconsidered it.

N-no, that's not important.
It sounded like #C236196003Archer#CDEF just showered
#C236196003BB#CDEF in praise…!

I mean, look. This TV show is like, all glitzy,
it feels like I fit right in!

Dammit.
I swung at her speedily without thinking.

Oww. Your comeback was so speedy…
But thanks to that, I snapped out of it!

By the way, mind giving me your
sparrow friend's number, #C236196003Caster#CDEF?

Waaaahhh…
I don't! I don't have such a thing!
#C236196003Gi-Gilgamesh#CDEF…?

Huh?
My improvised "Adore #C236196003BB#CDEF Brainwashing Song"
was cleared away?

…tch.
#C236196003Rani#CDEF is a real pain, huh?
And with that, we'll call it a day.

It's time for #C000246204BB Channel#CDEF,
the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF's No. 1 extravaganza!

Heckling won't get you anywhere!
Get that through your head, Mister, umm…

There's no getting used to this excitement.
It's not just because of the studio's
bizarre ambiance.
What's that look for, #[Grandpa][Grandma]#?
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF is the Sentinel!

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF looks away,
so as not to make eye contact.
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF, wait――!
Annnd scene!鷙
Compared to her, you should be thankful to #C236196003BB#CDEF―

After hearing her say that, seeing that she clearly
intends not to, my rolled up fist starts shaking on its own.

She may have gone rogue,
but she must be up to something.
"Cutting a deal"――? What is #C236196003BB#CDEF after?
#C000246204BB Channel#CDEF―On air now!
#C236196003BB#CDEF'S☆THREE-MINUTE COOKOUT!
Let's have the staff savor it.
What IS "3-Minute Cooking," anyway?

My mood has gone out the window.
Menu change!

Say whateeever you like.
Time to set the microwave☆
#C236196003BB#CDEF proudly takes the dish out.

………?
It looks empty…
*sigh*. It happens.
She sprinkles a pinch of #RUBS  resources#RUBEseasoning#REND over the empty dish.
Then, something red started swelling forth――
She hasn't leaked a single #C000246204SG#CDEF.
So I hope you look forward to it!
It's a surprise, Senpai.鷙
You ravenous bunch have fun now!
Good evening, one and all!
Welcome to the #C000246204BB Channel#CDEF!

………………………
I was a fool to think she ran out of games.
Tada～! Yep! Swimsuits!

Please don't worry.
Fulfilling that order will be me, #C236196003BB#CDEF!
However…

Transcending space and time?
What's going on here?
Well, it's no big deal.
That girl never listens to me anyway.

Anyone who says they don't
will learn what pleasure is.
Your cheers aren't worth anything.

……?
#C236196003BB#CDEF is acting strange.
But, this #C236196003BB#CDEF is――
Hmm?

Cameraman, were you recording right?
There was a weird gap just now.
Ahem. Sorry.
#C236196003BB#CDEF's work has finally come to a head.
I see…

After I chip away at this barrier,
I'll reach the goal.

Therefore,
I'll let #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF take care of you guys.
Now, have a good day, Senpai.
#C000246204BB!!! CHANNEL!!!!!#CDEF

Please stoooopp!
Mini-skirt policewoman #C236196003BB#CDEF-chan coming through!

Not only has Senpai gone silent,
but so has the Servant…

Actually,
are you STILL defying me?

"Why did all this happen?"
It's about the cause, Senpai.

To everyone in front of the monitor―
Good evening.

It's time for the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF's most highly viewed
and popular content: #C000246204BB Channel#CDEF.
The host is everyone's antagonist imp: #C236196003BB#CDEF.

The viewers are all of the sad little sheep
shut inside the old school.

You there, with the kelp-looking hair.
Nothing will come of kicking and screaming,
you know?

You can't close your eyes.
You can't plug up your ears.

This is a brain-shaking nightmare liable to
snatch you away from reality.

That's right! Once it starts, you have to
watch until the end: a roller coaster movie!

Hehe. I'm so eager to please that it makes
me blush, if I say so myself!

Wha… what's going on!?
One second I'm in the Student Council Room,
and now I'm in a studio.

Actually, rather than being in a studio,
I'm seeing a studio.

There's nothing else around but that.
I can't see my own hands and feet,
let alone #C236196003Leo#CDEF, #C236196003Rin#CDEF, and the others.
It's like I've been turned into a camera…!

Ah. I'm not permitting questions either.
Since only #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF-senpai has
speaking rights―

#C236196003Leo#CDEF, #C236196003Rin#CDEF, and the rest of you, please
stay quiet.

Now then. In today's #C000246204BB Channel#CDEF, I'll be
explaining the basic rules.
Today's topic: "How can we make our escape!?"
Hey everyone, you want to know, yes?

Silly me was so amused by Senpai's amazement,
I ended up playing around.

In the middle of the studio,
#C236196003BB#CDEF giggles with a smile on her face.

…however, she just said something terrible.
#C236196003BB#CDEF said, "I was planning to finish off #C236196003Rin#CDEF."

Though from the tone of her voice,
it could also be taken as a joke…

That was no joke. That girl is serious.
There's no laughter in those eyes.

…her eyes hold no laughter, I see.
That dark-colored #C236196003Sakura#CDEF… hmm… #C236196003Dark Sakura#CDEF?
She was seriously intent on killing #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

It doesn't seem to be a jest. That woman's
existence itself is strange, but the whirlpool
of madness within her is genuine.

That woman―――Her body retains the appearance
of a person, but it's already become a deadly
poison, worse than #RUBS slime#RUBEfilth#REND.

Ahh. Because you're contracted with Senpai,
you're also sharing speaking rights.

Ahh. Because you're contracted with Senpai,
you're also sharing speaking rights.

Ahh. Because you're contracted with Senpai,
you're also sharing speaking rights.

Ahh. Because you're contracted with Senpai,
you're also sharing speaking rights.

Ermm. As #C236196003Leo#CDEF guessed, after you go through the
#C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF, there IS an exit.

If you want to escape from the #C000246204Far Side
of the Moon#CDEF, just breaking through the
Labyrinth will be okay!

But that alone won't be any fun, don't
you think?

That's why I've appended a special #RUBS   program#RUBEtechnique#REND
to the Labyrinth.
Now―time for a question鷙

What is this special technique?
Senpai, do you know?
Ding ding! That's right!

Well, obviously you'd know. If you chose wrong
there, I would've given you the 8-bit
special, Senpai.

A-and here i-it is!
You're something else, Senpai!
But unfortunately, that's incorrect.

If I had my way, I would want to say that
that's correct, but alas, I'm a host right now.
The correct answer is Shield. Or Wall too.

Please pick up on the social cues, okay,
imbecile little 8-bitty #[boy][girl]#?
THAT'S the new #RUBS   program#RUBEtechnique#REND, #C236196003BB#CDEF's pride and joy!

"In the Labyrinth's Core…
A girl-integrated…?"

That's right. When it comes to resources,
using humans or AI makes no difference.

Please think of it as an honor that they're
being treated equally, rather.
Truly, it was an excellent wall, was it not?

A girl's mind is complicated and mysterious.
There's no firmer wall than that鷙

The downside is the limited size and amounts,
I suppose.

A single girl's worth of mind can plaster three
floors to the very brim.

An outstanding Master that can be used as a
Core…

Female Masters of dense quasi-Spiritrons are
rare resources, so they're hard to find.

Out of all the Masters I captured,
I only used #C236196003Rin#CDEF and that girl as Cores.
Hehehe… now for some introductions!

With an intellectual white gown, glasses, and a
shiny forehead―the precipitous / smooth,
slender beauty!

Yes! She's the pride of Atlas Institute:
Earth's last homunculus!

"What lies under her cardigan?"
"Does the Atlas Institute have no concept of
shame?"
Thinking about it makes my heart pound too!
Go ahead. You can make a statement, you know?

Let's hear your scathing comments on these
puppies who will be challenging you from
here on out!

―――#C236196003BB#CDEF. I don't like playing up for
the cameras.

If they intrude into the fourth floor,
I'll simply treat them as foreign
invaders―and dispose of them.
Miss #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF was just the beginning, a demo.

I will prove―――just how dangerous a
structure reflecting a young girl's heart
can be.
…what's this I feel?

I can't see or hear her, but right now,
I feel like #C236196003Rin#CDEF is loudly booing next to me.

Okay鷙 Thank you very much for the promising
commentary鷙

A plain and simple game is no fun.
This design doesn't exist in the Near Side's
#C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF…

If you want to reach the outside,
then please defeat the unconquerable #C236196003Rani#CDEF.

This is the #C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF. In exchange
for dropping out of the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF, you've
all been freed from its rules.

"The defeated are terminated"――
Well, such a rule doesn't apply here anymore.

As long as you're here, there's no need to
vanish.

…though, having that health management AI
there keeping you company really pisses
me off…

I AM the one with a compassion deeper than
an ocean: #C236196003BB#CDEF.

As long as you all stay in the school,
I'll leave you all alone.

I can't guarantee your civil rights,
but I'll recognize your freedom as it is.

You're each free to have any dreams or
delusions you please.

Your intracerebral simulators run on rather
embarrassing forces, ones characteristic to
humans.

Please keep discharging your young libidos,
everyone.
I'm always in that Labyrinth,
wanting and wanting to kill you all,
Unfortunately, you didn't step on anything!
Hurriedly bumbling through a minefield…

Our "Three Ns"―nonchalant, noncaring and
nonpolitical―Senpai is being attacked by
an assault-type variety show.

The dishonest, inescapable,
#C000246204BB Channel#CDEF――starting now!

Wh-what on Earth!? The world shifted out of
nowhere!? Video!? Is this another video!?

Good evening, Senpai! …oh, come now!
When you're greeted, you greet back, don't you?
Repeat after me: happy-very-merry good evening!

What'd you say?
I can't hearrr youuu!

Soo, in this video, the talented,
beautiful, and erudite #C236196003BB#CDEF…

…will star in this MAD movie,
recorded a hundred or so years ago.

Thus, please leave your grievances, objections,
complaints, and charity cases at the door.

Ah. But I'm always available if Senpai has a
love letter for me.

Of course, the moment I get it, what's stopping
me from slapping it online and tossing it in a
dumpster?

I'm all ears if you've got any good jokes
for me.

What's with this off-the-rails cattiness of #C236196003BB#CDEF?
#C236196003Sakura#CDEF would never act like this, so it's hard
seeing them share the same model.

She's the exact opposite of the docile #C236196003Sakura#CDEF.
Is this what so-called "overheating" looks like?

Women are often full of mysteries and who knows?
Maybe what we've seen from #C236196003Sakura#CDEF and #C236196003BB#CDEF
are two symptoms of the same disease.

I beg your pardon, freak? How dare a ticking
time bomb of a woman like you accuse my Darling
of EVER wanting to write you a love letter!

The difference between them doesn't look so
marginal now, does it? Pitiful. It's not a love
letter she needs―it's a restraining order.
Cut the laugh reel, if you don't mind.

You Servants are only good for your nutrients,
but I don't like my food talking to me,
thank you.

This is how any natural conversation between
Senpai and me sounds. Couldn't you tell?
Why don't you just go with the flow?

Don't belittle me! I can go with any flow――!
And hey! You CAN see us, can't you, you brat!

…"video" my ass.
We're all being shot in real time, aren't we?

Hm. I just got the most annoying inkling:
did I have ties to #C236196003BB#CDEF in a previous life?

Very well. To be cautious, I'll swallow my
pride. I won't turn my back to you.

Just so you know, both this studio and #C000246204BB
Channel#CDEF are indestructible.

Any strike you make will be wasted.
Or rather, I should say that any effort you make
will be wasted.

Senpai lost #[his][her]# memories.
That Servant was reinitialized.
And… #C236196003BB#CDEF is drop-dead gorgeous!

Why do you keep dragging your heels when you
could remember your place in all this?

The principles that drive humans like you,
Senpai, are incomprehensible to me.
As a matter of fact, I find it fascinating!

Not playing around with such delightful #RUBS  toys #RUBEhumans#REND
is an unacceptable waste.

Yes――Senpai and the rest of you are better off
as birds kept forever in my cage.

I'll never let you leave the #C000246204Far Side of the
Moon#CDEF.

I mean, sounds a lot like school anyways,
doesn't it?

#C236196003BB#CDEF is the school's regulation and its restraint.
It'd be best for you to obey me without a fuss,
if you catch my drift.
Annnyhoo, let me leave it at that for now.

Since I'm so busy, I won't be facing against
you. But please don't go off dying on your own,
okay?

Hold on! There's something I need to ask
before this is over――!

A question…?
Come on, I TOLD you this was a video.
What a hopeless Senpai you are!

If it's only one question, I'll answer it.
You have the floor.
Why do you call me "Senpai"?
Why do you call me "Senpai"? #C246168255薗#CDEF
I need to find out what #C236196003BB#CDEF's goal is.

Why is she preying on Servants and bringing
all these Masters to the #C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF?

#C236196003Leo#CDEF and #C236196003Rin#CDEF were saying that her goal was to
"expand her functionality," but is that really
her only aim?

For reasons I myself don't understand,
my body repulsed at the sound of her reply.
An indescribable anger lurched from my chest.

The sense in my mind, no, in my very bones that
#C236196003BB#CDEF's words just now were lies hit me with
a certain sting of whiplash.

You get it, don't you? Treat it like the
bloodrush you might get when unboxing a present.

If you can make it to where I am now, Senpai,
I'll tell you everything you want to know.

Although, I feel you should savor the time you
have NOT knowing the truth while you still can.
Why can't we talk things out right here and now?

A human like me might not appreciate #C236196003BB#CDEF's goal,
but wouldn't it be best for everyone involved
if we straightened things out without combat?

How many times do I have to tell you that
is this a recorded movie?

Do so, and maybe you'll figure out my intentions
before so much as finding me.

Diplomacy was off the table long before you
got here.

I understand being called that by #C236196003Sakura#CDEF,
but it sounds wrong from #C236196003BB#CDEF,
who has no relation to me whatsoever.

Eh? Well, it's just easier to call you that.
Doesn't it have a nice ring to it? "Senpai."

I just t-took a heavy hit…!
I feel like I was blown to the farthest side
of the studio!

Is it fine for me to have this? No, wait.
Why did #C236196003BB#CDEF have a
#C000246204SG#CDEF in the first place!?
I don't have anything special to add.
I'm not at all interested.
"Not interested" times a million-bajillion.
I-I still think you'd better try to find out!

Who WOULDN'T want to know the motives of
a boss like me, who can bend an entire world
to her will, am I right?

I'm a blaze, burning higher and higher
with the purest determination!

This is a once in a lifetime opportunity to
Digivolve from a Rookie Senpai into an
Ultimate Senpai. Or a MEGA Senpai!

…please. You might say that, but watch, the
second I act curious, you're going to respond to
all my questions with, "It's a secret!鷙"

It would be much more worthwhile to me
to be searching the Labyrinth right about now.

Grr! You're asking for "something" all right,
Senpai…

I'll give my foolish Senpai onnne mooore chance
to play along.

Alright, ask away.
For realsies, this is your last chance to.

Good morning.
It's time for a secret,
late night broadcast.

Today's host will be I,
Tsukumihara's covert Student Council President,
Queen of the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF――#C236196003BB#CDEF!

And… we bring you this bum I happened to
pick up off the street who goes by the pen name,
"#C236196003Greenchee#CDEF"!鷙

Right! Now, let's give our spoony #C236196003Greenchee#CDEF
a prize to match:
Transcendent☆Corporal Punishment Beeeam!鷙

I modded my water gun a tad much and
overclocked its damage output.

Bleh. I'm back from the dead.
A lot must've happened after I lost that
last Health Point.

By the way, #C236196003Greenchee#CDEF.
What do you think about the public's total
disregard for morals these days?

"My Rooms," this. "Changing outfits," that… 
That's waaay too scandalous, no?
Nuh-uh. The way you act is what's scandalous!

Friendly adolescent talks in the Student Council
Room, flirting in the hallway without a care in
the world or who sees.

At any rate, I won't allow it anymore.
That's why I'm proposing a new school #ROFS-007#RUBSregulation#RUBErule#REND!

Talking is now prohibited.
Do your best to communicate through eye contact.

Just so you know, #C000246204Return Crystals are also
sealed#CDEF.☆

Take this as an opportunity to pull out with
your Servant.

And so, without further ado…
I bid all the NPCs of this school "farewell"!
This has been your Nightly Honey Broadcast!
Dun-dun-dun-dun-dun.

Dun-dun-dun-dun-dun, dun-dun-dun.
Dun-dun-dun-dun-dun-dun-dun…!

Resounding through the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF is a playful,
stylish sound effect…

Is it a drum roll of fate?
Or the resentful voices of unrevenged NPCs?
Or the sound of a drill, whittling away stone?

Tonight you'll be drawn into a black, bloody world;
the new, rumored program―――

Welcome to [Heartful☆Cursed Night
―just some easy ghost stories from school]!

I will be your host, the heroine of this ghost
story, if you'll let me tell it:
Could it be that this girl is merely a nitwit?

…here's the sight-jack without letting us
consent, as per tradition.
Every time, without fail.

…*sigh*. I want to change the channel, but
she's got the remote. The Student Council Room's
security sure has a lot of holes…

Here it is. The circuitous and backfiring
customary approach. You deal with her, mongrel.

…so it started, huh?
Since I was kinda prepared and expecting it,
I'm not that surprised.

I wonder if #C236196003BB#CDEF shoehorns this plot of hers in
if she ever thinks she has a weakness.
Huh? You're spoiling the fun, Senpai.

Jeez, and here I was pausing my construction
to play with you. #C236196003BB#CDEF is so sad now. Sniffle.

Praetor, I feel torn. I like unique theater,
so I don't want to go about criticizing
the actress…

But this isn't good. Truly, not at all.
